munit:test.name: TC-01-valid-new-product-returns-NEW
munit:test.description: A fully valid product with no existing record is classified as NEW

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { sku : "SKU-001", productName : "Wireless Headphones", categoryCode : "ELEC-AUDIO", brand : "SoundMax", price : 2499.00, currency : "INR", taxClass : "GST-18", stockStatus : "IN_STOCK", productStatus : "ACTIVE", shortDescription: "Over-ear wireless headphones with noise cancellation", imagePath : "/img/products/sku-001.jpg" }

munit-tools:assert-that.message: TC-01: classification should be NEW
TC-01: sku should be SKU-001
TC-01: no validation errors expected
TC-01: new product is always customer-facing
TC-01: no price review for new product

TC-06: no customer-facing change expected
